questions.question: Explain how neurotransmitters are involved in communication between neurons.
questions.solution_html:
• Neurotransmitters are the chemical messengers that transmit signals from one neuron to
  • another, or from neurons to target cells such as muscle cells or other types of neurons.

  • which is the small gap between the sending neuron (presynaptic neuron) and the receiving
  • neuron (postsynaptic neuron). This release occurs in response to an electrical impulse
  • (action potential)in thepresynaptic neuron.

  • that connects motor signals between the brain and spinal cord. It contains important
  • structures like the substantia nigra, which produces dopamine needed for smooth and

questions.question: How does the midbrain contribute to the regulation of movement and coordination?
questions.solution_html:
• ● The midbrain helps regulate movement and coordination by acting as a control center
  • that connects motor signals between the brain and spinal cord. It contains important
  • structures like the substantia nigra, which produces dopamine needed for smooth and
  • purposeful movements, and the red nucleus, which helps coordinate limb movements.
  • The midbrain also integrates sensory information—especially visual and auditory cues—
  • to guide reflexive actions and ensure the body adjusts its movements accurately.
questions.final_answer: to guide reflexive actions and ensure the body adjusts its movements accurately
